name: Double Date
source:
Alice is a disaster when it comes to asking women out. But when she adopts a dog from the shelter, she wasn't expecting to be knocked over by an absolutely cute lady who makes her want to try. When their dogs help them meet again, Alice starts to fall for Sophie. Will she be able to get her feelings across? Featuring the best wingdogs, Dani and Apple!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝在约女人出去方面简直就是一场灾难。但当她从收容所收养一只狗时，她没想到会被一位绝对可爱的女士撞倒，这让她想尝试一下。当他们的狗帮助他们再次见面时，爱丽丝开始爱上索菲。她能表达自己的感受吗？拥有最好的翼犬丹尼和苹果！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538520/]Steam[/url]]
